summary: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, issued a $191,475 unsecured promissory note to its sponsor, HWei Super Speed Co. Ltd., to fund a trust account extension for its initial business combination. The non-interest-bearing note matures upon a business combination; if none occurs, the note is forgiven. The sponsor may convert the unpaid balance into units at $10.00 per unit upon a business combination. This filing is a routine SPAC extension funding mechanism, not a special situation—it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or abrupt management change. The event is a standard operational step without new substantive deal terms.
